lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, main Kaveri Finance se bol raha hoon. Rahul Bansal ji baat kar rahe hain?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir aapke two-wheeler loan pe do EMI overdue hain, three thousand nine hundred each, total seven thousand eight hundred, plus eleven eighty bounce charges. Aaj kab tak clear karenge?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: क्या? October की EMI तो मैंने Karol Bagh branch में cash जमा की थी। मेरे पास receipt है।
lines.roman: Kya? October ki EMI toh maine Karol Bagh branch mein cash jama ki thi. Mere paas receipt hai.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir system mein toh nahi dikh raha. Payment toh karna padega, warna charges badhte rahenge.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: देखिए, मैं double payment नहीं करूँगा। पहले आप अपना record check कीजिए। Receipt number भी है, KB दो चार आठ नौ।
lines.roman: Dekhiye, main double payment nahi karoonga. Pehle aap apna record check kijiye. Receipt number bhi hai, KB do chaar aath nau.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay sir, main dispute raise kar deta hoon. Aapka reference number hai DSP four five one two. Branch receipt verify karegi, seven working days mein resolution aa jayega.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ठीक है। और तब तक मुझे ये calls आती रहेंगी?
lines.roman: Theek hai. Aur tab tak mujhe ye calls aati rahengi?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir woh system automatic hai, main kuch nahi kar sakta. Waise November ki EMI toh disputed nahi hai na, woh aap bhar sakte hain.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: November की salary अभी आई नहीं है। Dispute clear होने दीजिए, फिर एक साथ देख लेंगे।
lines.roman: November ki salary abhi aayi nahi hai. Dispute clear hone dijiye, phir ek saath dekh lenge.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir bas dhyan rakhiye, overdue chalta raha toh credit bureau mein report hota hai, CIBIL pe asar padega.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: हाँ समझ गया। पहले मेरा issue solve कीजिए।
lines.roman: Haan samajh gaya. Pehle mera issue solve kijiye.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Theek hai sir. Toh recap kar deta hoon: dispute reference DSP four five one two, seven working days mein branch receipt verify hogi, uske baad hum aapko call karenge.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer disputes the October EMI, saying he paid cash at the Karol Bagh branch and holds a receipt; a dispute ticket was raised.
analysis.summary: Borrower claims the October EMI was paid in cash at a branch and refuses to pay until records are corrected. Agent logged dispute DSP4512 with a 7-working-day timeline but could not confirm a pause on collection calls and secured no payment.
analysis.observations: Dispute was logged cleanly with a reference and timeline, and consequences were explained factually. However, there was no recording disclosure, the agent opened by demanding payment instead of asking what happened, and he brushed off the request to pause calls ('system automatic hai').
analysis.improvements: Disclose recording and verify with account digits; ask about the missed payments before demanding a date; confirm that collection follow-ups pause during dispute review; assess capacity for the undisputed November EMI rather than just asking him to pay it.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Borrower confirmed his name before dues were discussed; no stronger check.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked 'kab tak clear karenge' instead of why the EMIs were missed; the dispute surfaced only because the customer raised it.

ds_empathy.rationale: Dismissed the cash receipt claim with 'payment toh karna padega'.

ds_ability_to_pay.rationale: Did not explore what the customer could pay after he mentioned salary not yet credited.

ng_state_dues.rationale: Stated two EMIs of ₹3,900, ₹7,800 total plus ₹1,180 bounce charges.

ng_options.rationale: Suggested paying the undisputed November EMI separately.

dp_log_ticket.rationale: Logged the dispute and shared reference DSP4512.

dp_timeline.rationale: Committed to resolution within seven working days.

dp_pause_collection.rationale: Said calls are automatic and he could not stop them.

cp_respectful.rationale: Curt in places but not abusive.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: No amount or date committed, even for the undisputed EMI.

cl_recap.rationale: Recapped reference number, timeline and next call.

moments.label: Claims Oct EMI paid in cash
